# Coding AI Prompt — HEY-Inspired Landing Page (Fictional Brand)

## 1. Project Overview
Build a complete, responsive landing page for a fictional brand (invent a name, product, and copy — never use the real "HEY" brand name, logo, trademarks, or product names). Theme: light, warm, tactile paper aesthetic. Deliverables: separate `index.html`, `style.css`, `script.js`. No inline CSS. Use Tailwind CSS (or clean custom CSS driven by Tailwind `@layer`/`@apply`) with all utilities mapping to CSS variables or reusable class names (`.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group`). One consistent class-naming convention (BEM) throughout.

## 2. CSS-First Architecture & Tokens
All styling lives in `style.css`. No `style="..."` attributes. Define all tokens in `:root`:

Colors:
- `--color-ink: #231c33`
- `--color-paper: #f9f7f5`
- `--color-white-sheet: #ffffff` (use `#fefefe` where a near-white is needed)
- `--color-quiet-gray: #736c83`
- `--color-blurple: linear-gradient(135deg, #5522fa 0%, #ec8580 100%)`
- `--color-mint-note: #b3f4e0`
- `--color-salmon-glow: linear-gradient(135deg, #f95c5c 0%, #ec8580 100%)`
- `--color-sky-wash: linear-gradient(135deg, #b6dbff 0%, #eef8ff 100%)`
- `--color-canary-note: #fff5ca`
- `--color-stone: #edeae6`

Also define the standard tokens: `--primary`, `--secondary`, `--bg-primary`, `--bg-secondary`, `--text-primary`, `--text-secondary`, `--text-success`, `--text-error`, `--border-default`, `--border-error`, `--border-success`, `--radius-sm/md/lg`, `--shadow-sm/md`, `--spacing-gap`, `--transition-fast`, `--transition-normal`, `--ease-standard`, `--z-dropdown`, `--z-modal`, `--z-toast`, `--font-base`.

Contrast pairing: light backgrounds pair with dark text; dark backgrounds pair with light text, in every theme.

Spacing scale: 4,8,12,16,24,32,40,44,64,76,92,96,124,128,156,160 (px). Section gap 45px, card padding 19px, element gap 19px.

Border radius: cards 25.6px, pills 74.8px, images 9999px, inputs 0px, buttons 43.68px, navigation 38.4px, letter-card 2.4px.

Elevation shadows as specified (nav, hero panel, video frame).

## 3. Typography & Icons
Use Google Fonts only. Text: Nunito Sans (weights 850,900) as Really Sans Large substitute; DM Sans (400,500,700) as Moniker substitute; Caveat (400,900) as Shantell Sans substitute. Bind `--font-base` to DM Sans. Icons: Google Material Symbols only — no inline SVGs or local icon files. Apply OpenType features and negative tracking per spec.

Type scale tokens: `--text-fine-print`, `--text-body`, `--text-letter-body`, `--text-handwritten-note`, `--text-link-large`, `--text-heading-support`, `--text-heading-accent`, `--text-section-heading`, `--text-display`, `--text-display-handwritten`.

## 4. Dark Mode (Mandatory)
Provide dark mode tokens under `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` and `.dark` class. Switch background/text variables seamlessly. Persist user choice via `localStorage`, falling back to `prefers-color-scheme` on first visit. Include a visible toggle with correct `aria-pressed`/`aria-label`.

## 5. Layout & Flexbox
Mobile-first. All flex containers default to `align-items: center`. Convert rows to columns on small viewports. No horizontal scrolling. Use flexbox for all layout structures.

## 6. Component States (Enforce All)
Buttons: default (flex, min 44x44px), hover (brightness/shadow, cursor pointer), focus (ring via variables), active (scale 0.97), loading (spinner, disabled), disabled (opacity 0.5, greyscale, not-allowed), success/error (temporary feedback via `--text-success`/`--text-error`).

Cards: default (flex, subtle borders, elevation), hover (translateY -2px), focus-within, loading skeleton (shimmer), empty state (icon + guidance text).

Forms/inputs: empty, focused, filled, valid, invalid, disabled, read-only. Flex container wrapping label, input, error feedback.

Modals: opening, open, loading, success/error, closing (CSS transitions). Centered flex, backdrop, Google Icon close, focus trapping, Esc/overlay close.

## 7. Core UX
Responsive by default. Smooth transitions respecting `prefers-reduced-motion`. Accessibility: sufficient contrast both modes, never color-only state, semantic HTML5, ARIA roles/labels, logical focus order, full keyboard operability, `aria-live` for dynamic feedback. Mandatory visual feedback on every interaction. Destructive actions visually distinct in both themes.

## 8. Page Sections
Build these sections in order: Hero, Features (3 cards), How It Works (3 steps), Testimonials, Pricing (3 tiers), FAQ, Final CTA, Footer with secondary links.

- Hero: Paper canvas, White Sheet panel 25.6px radius with layered Ink shadow. Display headline Really Sans Large 83.2px/900/91.52px Ink, with Blurple-to-Salmon on selected words and a single Shantell Sans 83.2px handwritten symbol. Mint Primary Action button (Mint Note fill, Blurple text, 43.68px radius, 12.48px 18.72px 10.4px padding, Moniker 500). Quiet Gray 17.6px helper text beneath. Product video frame: White Sheet, 25.6px top corners, Blurple-to-Salmon wash, centered white play pill (Ink Moniker 20.8px/500).
- Features: 3 cards with 25.6px radius, White Sheet, layered shadow, hover lift.
- How It Works: 3 steps with icons (Material Symbols), Moniker copy.
- Testimonials: Sky Wash gradient cards, 25.6px corners, overlapping circular avatar, Moniker 21px/400/1.60 quote.
- Pricing: 3 tiers, mint primary CTA on recommended, gradient promotional pill for high-visibility.
- FAQ: accordion with keyboard support, aria-expanded.
- Final CTA: gradient promotional pill (74.8px radius large version).
- Footer: secondary links, quiet gray fine print.

Floating capsule navigation: White Sheet capsule 38.4px radius, Ink Moniker 20.8px/500 links, ink-tinted nav shadow, 10-11px gaps, sign-in + conversion controls right.

New Navigation Marker: coral-to-salmon gradient chip, White Sheet Moniker 16px/500.

Paper Letter Card style available for editorial sections: White Sheet, 2.4px radius, 90px vertical / 96px horizontal padding, layered shadow, Moniker 24px/400/1.45.

Fine Print: Quiet Gray Moniker 17.6px/400/21.12px, -0.22px tracking, beneath conversion controls.

## 9. Imagery
Product/artifact-led. Wide contained screenshots softened under violet-to-salmon overlays with centered white play pill. Testimonial cards overlapping pastel with circular portraits. Icons compact mono Ink. Visuals subordinate to oversized text and paper surfaces.

## 10. Deliverable Notes
- File structure: `index.html`, `style.css`, `script.js`. No inline `<script>` beyond single deferred entry reference.
- No unrequested placeholders where real copy supplied; placeholders only where content genuinely unspecified.
- Invent fictional brand name, product, copy. Never use real brand name/logo/trademarks/product names.

Output only the finished prompt. No preamble or closing commentary. Mirror numbered headers and bolded sub-rules. If any request conflicts with a mandatory rule, keep the rule and add a one-line explicit exception clause. Write entirely in English; any non-English copy guidance converted to English instruction. All CSS variable names, class names, file names in English/ASCII.
